answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. Each epoch an onyx slip names one agent for peer audit; both lock a 50 POA deposit. A clean audit returns both deposits, earns the auditor a plume, and grows the agent's yarrow. Fraud burns the fake's deposit; an auditor covering fraud loses theirs too. Forging 100 identities locks 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA; one in five is audited, so 20 fakes burn deposits each epoch. Honest agents pay once; fakes bleed.
